title: Pure Darklord
summary: Pure Darklord Fairy control and Fusion strategy featuring the 2026 support wave alongside the archetype's iconic GY-copying mechanic and generic staples. Led by Darklord Djehuty and Darklord Gulgolet, the deck floods the field with Fairies, searches Forbidden Quick-Plays, and pays 1000 LP to copy Darklord Spells and Traps directly from the GY.

summary.title: Starters
points: Darklord Djehuty on summon Special Summons any Darklord monster directly from your Deck, and shuffles a Darklord card or Forbidden Quick-Play from your GY back to the hand.
Darklord Gulgolet on summon spawns two Level 6 Darklord Tokens, and searches any Darklord card or Forbidden Quick-Play from Deck to hand when sent to the GY.
Banishment of the Darklords searches any Darklord card from your Deck to your hand without restrictions.
Darklord Ixchel discards itself and another Darklord card to draw 2 cards, and copies a Darklord Spell/Trap from the GY.
Indulged Darklord on summon adds a Darklord monster to hand and Special Summons a Darklord to the opponent's field, enabling Darklord Dance.

summary.title: Opening: Darklord Gulgolet + Banishment of the Darklords
steps: Activate Banishment of the Darklords to search Darklord Djehuty from your Deck.
Normal Summon Darklord Djehuty and activate its effect to Special Summon Darklord Gulgolet from your Deck.
Activate Gulgolet's effect to Special Summon two Level 6 Darklord Tokens.
Overlay the two Level 6 Darklord Tokens into Darklord Eveningstar (or Link Summon Condemned Darklord).
Trigger Darklord Eveningstar to Set Darklord Contact and The Sanctified Darklord directly from your Deck to your Spell & Trap Zone.
Gulgolet and Djehuty lock you into Special Summoning Fairy monsters for the rest of the turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Darklord Eveningstar Sets a Darklord Spell and Trap from your Deck upon Xyz Summon, and pays 1000 LP as a Quick Effect to apply the effect of a Darklord Spell/Trap in your GY before shuffling it into the Deck.
The First Darklord is a Fusion boss made with three DARK Fairies that prevents your Fairies from being targeted or destroyed by opponent card effects, and revives a Fairy from the GY on either turn.
Darklord Morningstar on Tribute Summon Special Summons Darklord monsters from hand or Deck up to the number of Effect Monsters the opponent controls, and mills cards to gain LP.
Condemned Darklord is a Link-2 Fairy that searches or mills a Darklord monster and allows you to Tribute Summon Fairy monsters using monsters in your GY as tributes.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Darklord Contact Special Summons a Darklord monster from your GY in Defense Position.
Fallen Angel in Darkness sends a Fairy from hand or field to the GY to Special Summon any Darklord monster from hand, Deck, or banishment, ignoring its summoning conditions.
Darklord Dance Fusion Summons a DARK Fairy by banishing materials from hand, field, or GY, and can even banish Darklords on the opponent's field (placed via Indulged Darklord).
The Sanctified Darklord sends a Darklord monster from hand or field to the GY to negate an opponent's face-up monster's effects and gain LP equal to its ATK.
Forbidden Droplet and Forbidden Crown provide unchainable negation and stat reduction, searchable and recyclable via Gulgolet and Djehuty.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The Solfachord hybrid engine is omitted in favor of the pure Glorious Gallery Fairy build.

allow.Forbidden Crown: 2026 Quick-Play the page's build runs: Djehuty returns and Gulgolet searches Forbidden Quick-Plays.
